يمترون (form VIII)
# يَمْتَرُونَ (yamtarūna) /jam.ta.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
# يُمْتَرَوْنَ (yumtarawna) /jum.ta.raw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
